title: Administrative Assistant, Community Schools Program | Richland County, Ohio | Up to $17/hr | Part Ti
description:
Job Title: Administrative Assistant, Community Schools Program | Richland County, Ohio | Up to $17/hr | Part Time - 21-13641

Spherion Mid Ohio's Professional Division is partnering with an established Richland County organization seeking a part time Administrative Assistant to support a Community Schools Program. This is a great opportunity for someone who is highly organized, detail oriented, tech comfortable, and excited to learn a unique administrative support role within an education focused environment.
This position will start at approximately 15-20 hours per week , with the potential to develop into full time down the road. There may be some limited hybrid flexibility over time, but this person should be comfortable working closely with the team, attending meetings, supporting school visits, and learning the community school sponsorship and compliance environment.

Pay and Schedule
This is a part time opportunity offering up to $17/hr , based on experience and overall fit. The schedule is expected to be approximately 15 to 20 hours per week , with flexibility available based on program needs and candidate availability.

What Makes This Opportunity Stand Out
This is a meaningful administrative support role where the right person can become a key part of a growing and highly collaborative program. The Community Schools Program supports 9 plus community and charter schools , helping with communication, compliance tracking, school support, documentation, and ongoing program coordination.
This person does not need to come in with a specific background in education. A background in education, education studies, school administration, compliance, nonprofit, or public sector work could be helpful, but it is not required. The bigger priority is finding someone who is organized, dependable, comfortable with technology, eager to learn, and able to manage details with care.

Key Responsibilities
Administrative and Program Support
  • Provide administrative support to the Community Schools Program team, including document management, scheduling, communication, and ongoing coordination.
  • Assist with tracking details, deadlines, records, school information, compliance items, and follow up needs.
  • Help maintain organized files, shared documents, calendars, and program materials.
  • Support communication between internal team members, schools, external partners, and other stakeholders.
Compliance and School Support
  • Assist with compliance tracking and documentation related to community and charter school sponsorship.
  • Help keep school partners informed of updates, deadlines, new requirements, and important reminders.
  • Assist with tracking legislation, bills, and education related updates for internal awareness.
  • Support preparation and follow up related to school visits, meetings, and required documentation.
Meetings, Minutes, and Communication
  • Assist with meeting coordination, agenda preparation, board meeting support, and meeting minutes.
  • Help prepare, format, and organize communication materials for schools and program partners.
  • Support newsletter creation, including taking provided information and turning it into a polished, professional communication piece.
  • Help create flyers, calendars, invitations, reminders, and other program materials.
Creative and Technology Support
  • Use tools such as Microsoft Office, Canva, email, calendars, shared files, and other programs to support the team.
  • Help make materials visually organized, professional, and easy to follow.
  • Learn new systems, processes, and platforms as needed.
  • Bring creativity, organization, and a willingness to jump in where needed.
What We're Looking For
  • Strong administrative, clerical, office support, or coordination experience.
  • Very strong attention to detail and follow through.
  • High level of organization and ability to manage multiple moving pieces.
  • Strong computer skills and comfort learning new systems and programs.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office Suite, email, calendars, document management, and general technology.
  • Canva experience is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to take information provided by others and turn it into polished written or visual communication.
  • Comfort working with internal teams, school representatives, outside partners, attorneys, and education related contacts.
  • Professional communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Someone who enjoys learning and is comfortable with a large learning curve.
Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate will be organized, curious, tech savvy, and dependable. This person should enjoy learning, be comfortable asking questions, and have the ability to become a "sponge” for new information. They will need to be comfortable working in a collaborative setting, supporting meetings, managing details, and helping the team stay organized.
This could be a great fit for someone with administrative experience who enjoys meaningful work, education related environments, compliance support, creative communication, and behind the scenes coordination.

Compensation and Benefits
  • This is a part time position offering up to $17/hr , based on experience and overall fit.
  • Benefits include a flexible schedule and an organizational discount for yourself or immediate family .
  • This position is expected to start at approximately 15 to 20 hours per week , with potential for growth into full time down the road.
Why This Role
This is a unique opportunity to support work that directly impacts community and charter schools. The right person will have the chance to learn a specialized program area, support meaningful school partnerships, contribute to newsletters and creative materials, assist with compliance tracking, and become a trusted administrative resource for the team.

title: Skilled Machine Operator | $25-$32/hr | Direct Hire
description:
Job Title: Skilled Machine Operator | $25-$32/hr | Direct Hire - 26-00182

Skilled Machine Operator | Permanent Night Shift 7p-7a | $25-$32/hr | Direct Hire

Permanent Night Shift (7p-7a) Opportunity | Training Conducted on 1st Shift (7a-7p)

Spherion Mid Ohio's Professional Division is partnered with a well-established organization in New Philadelphia, Ohio seeking skilled Machine Operators to join their production team. This direct hire opportunity offers long-term career stability, structured training, competitive compensation, and opportunities for future advancement.

This is not a basic production role. The ideal candidate will bring strong mechanical aptitude, math skills, attention to detail, and the ability to read and follow detailed job orders in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

What Makes This Opportunity Stand Out

Permanent night shift position in specialized production environment

Direct hire opportunity with long-term growth potential

Competitive pay from $25 to $32/hr, based on experience

Structured training program for candidates with strong transferable skills

Opportunity to advance into lead or supervisory roles

Key Responsibilities

The Skilled Machine Operator will be responsible for setting up, operating, and troubleshooting high-speed production equipment used to create finished products.

Responsibilities include:

• Set up and operate specialized production machinery
• Read and follow detailed job orders and production specifications
• Make machine adjustments for setup, quality, and production accuracy
• Monitor production runs to ensure efficiency and quality standards
• Troubleshoot equipment issues and make adjustments as needed
• Perform preventative maintenance on equipment
• Pull, inspect, and review product samples throughout production
• Lead or direct a small crew during production runs
• Maintain a safe, organized, and productive work area

What We're Looking For

Qualified candidates should have:

• Strong mechanical aptitude
• Machine operating experience in a skilled production environment
• Experience with machine setup, adjustments, troubleshooting, or changeovers
• Ability to read job orders, work instructions, and basic machine documentation
• Intermediate math skills
• Experience using rulers, calipers, or other measuring devices
• Ability to use hand tools for setup and adjustment
• Strong attention to detail and quality
• Ability to problem-solve in real time
• Strong attendance and reliability
• Ability to work with minimal supervision
• Ability to lead, direct, or support a small production crew

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate may come from a background in:

• Printing or bindery operations
• Packaging or converting
• High-speed manufacturing
• CNC or precision machine operation
• Skilled machine setup, troubleshooting, and changeover environments
• Industrial maintenance or mechanically intensive manufacturing environments

Candidates with strong transferable mechanical, production, and troubleshooting skills are encouraged to apply.

Schedule

Permanent Night Shift Position

Selected candidates will complete training on day shift (7a-7p) before transitioning to their permanent night shift (7p-7a) assignment.

Schedule details include:

• Training conducted on day shift (7a-7p)
• Permanent placement on night shift (7p-7a)
• Overtime may be available or required based on production needs

Compensation and Benefits

• $25 to $32/hr, based on experience
• Medical, dental, and vision benefits
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid time off
• Paid holidays
• Long-term growth potential

Why This Role

This is a strong opportunity for someone who enjoys hands-on machine operation, mechanical problem-solving, and taking ownership of production quality. The company is willing to train the right person with strong aptitude, reliability, and a desire to build a long-term career in a specialized skilled role with opportunities for future growth and advancement.

This position is permanently assigned to night shift following completion of training on day shift.

title: Maintenance Technician | Richland County, Ohio | $25/hour
description:
Job Title: Maintenance Technician | Richland County, Ohio | $25/hour - 26-00173

Maintenance Technician | Richland County, Ohio | $25/hour

The Professional Division of Spherion Mid Ohio is partnered with a strong and stable organization in Richland County, Ohio seeking an Maintenance Technician to support equipment, facility, mechanical, electrical, and preventative maintenance needs.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys troubleshooting, variety, and being part of a team that jumps in where needed. The ideal candidate will bring a strong mix of mechanical and electrical maintenance experience, some HVAC background, and the ability to troubleshoot and replace controls components.

This position offers compensation of up to $25/hour, based on experience, along with first shift (6am-2:30pm) hours, limited overtime, very rare on call expectations, and a full range of benefits.

What Makes This Opportunity Stand Out
This is a balanced maintenance role with approximately 50 percent mechanical and 50 percent electrical work. Landscaping and heavy tow motor repairs are contracted out, allowing this person to focus more directly on equipment maintenance, facility support, controls troubleshooting, HVAC support, preventative maintenance, and hands on repair work.

Key Responsibilities
• Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair on facility and production related equipment.
• Support both mechanical and electrical maintenance needs.
• Troubleshoot and replace controls components, including Allen Bradley systems.
• Assist with HVAC troubleshooting, repairs, and routine maintenance.
• Diagnose equipment issues, repair or replace parts, test equipment, and make adjustments.
• Support preventative maintenance on shop machines, equipment, and facility needs.
• Assist with routine tow motor maintenance while larger repairs are handled by outside vendors.
• Perform basic fabrication, welding, soldering, and repair work as needed.
• Use hand tools, power tools, and maintenance equipment safely and effectively.
• Report to the Shop Supervisor and help support daily maintenance needs across the team.

What We're Looking For
• Prior maintenance experience in an industrial, manufacturing, facility, equipment, or shop environment.
• Strong mechanical troubleshooting and repair experience.
• Strong electrical troubleshooting and repair experience.
• Some HVAC background or related hands on exposure.
• Ability to troubleshoot and replace controls components.
• Allen Bradley experience is preferred.
• PLC programming or editing experience is not required.
• Hydraulic, pneumatic, mechanical, and industrial maintenance experience is helpful.
• Basic fabrication, welding, or soldering experience is strongly preferred.
• Team player mentality with a willingness to jump in where needed.
• Dependable, hands on, and comfortable supporting a variety of maintenance needs.

Ideal Candidate Profile
The strongest candidate will be a well rounded Maintenance Technician who is comfortable working across both mechanical and electrical maintenance. This person does not need to be a PLC programmer, but should be able to troubleshoot controls, identify issues, replace components, and support equipment uptime.

Compensation and Benefits
• Compensation around $25/hour, based on experience.
• First shift schedule, Monday through Friday, 6:00 AM to 2:30 PM.
• Limited overtime.
• Very rare on call expectation.
• Full range of benefits offered.
• Direct hire opportunity with long term stability.

Why This Role
This is a strong opportunity for a maintenance professional who wants first shift, variety, stability, and a role where both mechanical and electrical skills are valued. The right person will be a key part of keeping the facility, equipment, and daily operations running smoothly.
Interested candidates may apply directly or email a resume to Jessica Johnson at JJohnson@spherionohio.com to learn more.

This is a direct hire opportunity. Day one, you are this company's employee. Never go through a temp to hire process.

title: Maintenance Engineering Technician
description:
Job Title: Maintenance Engineering Technician - 25-00989

Job Description:
Spherion Mid-Ohio is seeking a Maintenance Engineering Technician for a direct hire position at a longstanding manufacturing firm in Ashland, Ohio.

Positions are available on 2nd shift with a pay rate of up to $40/hour (approx $83,200 annually) and excellent benefits that begin on day one!

***This is a direct hire opportunity with NO temp-to-hire process***

The Maintenance Engineering Technician is an elevated technical role that will maintain and troubleshoot advanced production equipment, including automated systems and robotics.

Responsibilities:
  • Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, robotic, and automated systems, utilizing PLCs, ladder logic, and HMIs to resolve faults.
  • Maintain and support automated production equipment such as robotics, conveyors, sensors, actuators, and control systems.
  • Maintain air compressors, lighting, and water systems, while also conducting regular facility inspections.
  • Perform scheduled maintenance on heading, threading, painting, packaging, and automation equipment.
  • Assist with equipment setup, installation, commissioning, and upgrades, following schematics and technical manuals.
  • Support alignment and tooling adjustments during changeovers, and provide operator assistance throughout production runs.
  • Accurately complete work orders, downtime logs, and maintenance records, and communicate repair timelines with production leads.
  • Monitor tool and parts usage, proactively requesting reorders to prevent downtime.
  • Collaborate with production, engineering, and quality teams, and train operators in basic troubleshooting and equipment maintenance.
  • Engage in root cause analysis and contribute to ongoing equipment performance enhancements.
  • Work independently without direct supervision, especially on back shifts, demonstrating a high level of maturity and the ability to understand priorities.
  • Adhere to OSHA standards, lockout/tagout procedures, and company safety policies, while actively participating in safety programs, audits, and corrective actions.
Qualifications:
  • 3+ years of experience in manufacturing maintenance
  • Strong Electrical Background is required, experience with Control Voltage, HMIs, 24V, and DC Voltage.
  • Proficiency with PLCs, ladder logic, and electrical/control system troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, electrical, and robotic systems
  • Ability to read blueprints, wiring diagrams, and technical manuals.
  • Associate's degree or technical certification in industrial maintenance is preferred.
  • Ability to communicate well, be proactive, demonstrate consistent drive and motivation
 
What’s in it for you?
With about 170 local employees, this company maintains a personal and close-knit environment in Ashland, while offering the stability and benefits of a global organization with over 30,000 employees.  There is potential for growth and advancement!

Compensation: Based on experience, up to $40/hr (approx $83,200 annually)

Benefits start day one, including:
  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • 401K with Company Match
  • PTO: 2 weeks’ vacation + 5 sick days
Schedule: 2nd shift, 3:00pm-11:00pm, Monday-Friday

Ready to take the next step? Apply today or reach out to Suzanne Thomas at sthomas@spherionohio.com to learn more about this opportunity!

title: Director of Marketing | Richland County, Ohio | Up to $100K
description:
Job Title: Director of Marketing - 26-00170

Director of Marketing | Richland County, Ohio | $75K to $100K

The Professional Division of Spherion Mid Ohio is partnered with a confidential organization in Richland County, Ohio seeking an experienced Director of Marketing to lead marketing strategy, brand visibility, customer engagement, digital marketing, local market awareness, and marketing team development.

This is a high visibility leadership opportunity for a marketing professional who can step into an established organization, take ownership, lead a small team, and bring stronger structure, consistency, creativity, and forward planning to the department. The ideal candidate will bring the confidence, communication skills, and practical marketing background needed to partner closely with leadership while helping support continued growth.

This position offers compensation range of up to $100K , based on experience, along with comprehensive benefits and paid time off.

What Makes This Opportunity Stand Out
This is an opportunity to step into an established organization where the Director of Marketing can enhance strategy, improve execution, strengthen planning, and help shape the future direction of the marketing function.

The Director of Marketing will oversee a small marketing team and will be expected to bring strong leadership, creative direction, digital marketing knowledge, and the ability to move initiatives forward. This person will play an important role in strengthening brand presence, improving customer engagement, supporting local marketing efforts, and ensuring marketing activity is intentional, organized, and aligned with business goals.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead overall marketing strategy, planning, campaign execution, and brand visibility efforts.
• Manage, coach, and develop a small marketing team while helping strengthen department structure, communication, accountability, and follow through.
• Build and maintain marketing calendars, promotional plans, content schedules, and forward planning initiatives.
• Lead social media strategy, content planning, scheduling, engagement, and awareness efforts.
• Support digital marketing initiatives, customer engagement campaigns, CRM activity, and targeted outreach.
• Help strengthen brand consistency, messaging, and market presence across the organization.
• Coordinate local marketing efforts, community partnerships, events, promotions, and engagement opportunities.
• Partner with leadership and internal teams to align marketing activity with business priorities and growth goals.
• Track marketing activity and performance to identify what is working, what needs adjusted, and where additional opportunities exist.
• Support new initiatives, special projects, and future growth needs as the organization continues to evolve.

What We're Looking For
• A minimum of five years of progressive marketing experience.
• Prior experience leading, coaching, or supporting a marketing team.
• Strong understanding of social media strategy, digital marketing, brand awareness, customer engagement, and local marketing.
• Experience creating marketing calendars, campaign plans, promotional strategies, and content schedules.
• Comfort using CRM tools, social media platforms, design tools, project management tools, and general marketing technology.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work cross functionally.
• Creative, strategic, organized, and able to move ideas into action.
• Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, priorities, and moving pieces.
• Ability to work independently and lead without heavy hand-holding.
• Professional, tactful, and able to manage sensitive or confidential information appropriately.
• Experience supporting marketing across multiple locations would be helpful, but not required.
• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field is preferred.

Ideal Candidate Profile
The strongest candidate will be a marketing leader who has worked beyond task-based execution and has served as a true partner to leadership and internal teams. This person should be comfortable leading people, organizing priorities, improving marketing structure, supporting customer engagement, and bringing ideas forward in a thoughtful and practical way.

We are looking for someone who can bring creativity, professionalism, accountability, and strong marketing direction while also fitting into a collaborative, growing, and hands-on company culture. Candidates currently at the Marketing Manager or Director level may be considered, depending on background, leadership experience, and overall scope.

Compensation and Benefits
• Compensation of up to $100K, based on experience.
• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.
• 401(k) program.
• Paid time off.

Schedule and Location
• Monday through Friday, 8am-5pm.
• Onsite in Richland County, Ohio.
• Occasional travel may be required for events, meetings, or business needs.

Why This Role
This is a unique opportunity for a proven marketing professional to step into a leadership role with an organization that is positioned for continued growth. The right person will have the ability to make an immediate impact, strengthen marketing execution, support team development, improve planning, and help elevate the overall marketing function.
This is a direct hire opportunity. Day one, you are this company's employee. Never go through a temp to hire process.

Interested candidates may apply directly or email a resume to Jessica Johnson at JJohnson@spherionohio.com to learn more.
